comment: Template for a consented local ASR corpus. Copy to manifest.json next to this file's parent (tools/jean-desktop/bench/manifest.json) and add rows ONLY for clips the operator recorded or otherwise has consent to benchmark locally. 'wav' resolves relative to this manifest; every clip must be 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV (the dictate.py / speech.py contract). 'reference' is the exact transcript a human verified. 'app_names' are phrases that must appear verbatim (after normalization) for the exact-match check. No clip content, transcript, or audio is committed to the repository.

clips.note: operator-recorded consented clip; keep the WAV outside version control
